Requirements: R-12
Plan row: TS-12

## Given

The reviewer has access to the downstream IaC, helm/values and CI/CD configuration repositories for the deployments. They are external to the repositories the factory can read.

## When

The reviewer searches those files for any reference to `CODE_EXECUTOR_SECURITY_THRESHOLD=LOW` and documents the result.

## Then

1. P-iac-clean: the audit finds NO file that pins `CODE_EXECUTOR_SECURITY_THRESHOLD=LOW`; no migration action is required.
2. P-iac-pinned: the audit finds one or more files pinning it; before merge the reviewer confirms an explicit migration plan exists for each.

Exactly one of P-iac-clean or P-iac-pinned applies.
